mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized growth > 2% does not lead to tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the last month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase does not correlate with economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous 3 months signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansionary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decrease does not correlate with supply chain disruptions.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is growing at an annualized rate below 2%, the real interest rate is high, signaling a restrictive monetary policy environment that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and low CPIAUCSL growth does not lead to a restrictive monetary policy environment.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, it signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease does not correlate with a tightening labor market.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the previous 6 months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansionary demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) grows by more than 2% annually and GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 3% annually, it signals a strong economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO annual growth > 2% and GDPC1 annual growth > 3%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of INDPRO and GDPC1 growth does not correlate with strong economic expansion.
